settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: Read the book page by page, listen to it with text-to-speech, and play free audio and video playlists from YouTube and Spotify. No login, no ads.
settings.contentBody: The book is bundled in the app. Audio and video play from YouTube and Spotify; we do not host them.

faq.a: Yes. No login and no ads.
Reading and text-to-speech work offline. Playlists from YouTube and Spotify need internet.
Open the book and tap Listen. The page is read aloud, then the next page opens automatically. It needs a Bengali voice installed in your phone's text-to-speech settings.

faq.q: Where does the audio come from?
faq.a: From the embedded YouTube and Spotify players. We do not host them.

faq.q: Where do the playlists come from?
faq.a: They are managed by us online and refresh each time the app opens.
